services.name: Harbor Cruise
services.desc: As a relaxing end to a busy day or to begin a night on the town, come aboard the Heritage for a jaunt around the Harbor. Relax with your favorite cocktail or local beer from our full service bar and enjoy the nighttime sights of the Seacoast. Immerse yourself in the beauty of a sunset, or view the spectacular lights of the city. Bring a friend and get away from the crowds. Join us! Lightly narrated. services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: Looking to host a memorable event? Consider a private boat ride aboard the M/V Heritage or the M/V Utopia! The M/V Heritage has a passenger capacity of 49 people while the M/V Utopia accommodates up to 28 guests! Whether you're planning an intimate gathering or a larger function, we’re here to make your event both unforgettable and easy to organize. A charter aboard the M/V Heritage is perfect for a wide variety of occasions, including family reunions, company outings, field trips, cocktail parties, wine tastings, weddings, rehearsal dinners, and surprise birthday celebrations. quotes.text: So glad I did this cruise So glad I did this cruise; it gave a fresh perspective on the Portsmouth area; On the 1h30min trip you will see a variety of interesting sites (e.g. two lighthouses, pass under at least two bridges, famous houses, an old jail, birds, and if you're lucky a harbor seal or two).Onboard commentary was great/audible and the boat itself was fine.Cruise price was reasonable (given today's rates)The only unfortunate bit is that they don't have onsite parking; prepare to spend some time looking for parking elsewhere prior to you trip — siddy666, September 2024

We loved it!! We loved it!! Brought my 4YO on this 10am cruise and we had a blast. We loved seeing the light houses, forts, bridges, and of course the navy yard with all of the cranes/trucks etc. Throughout the tour the captain gave some great facts about each sight.I will say seating was a bit more limited than on other boats so definitely get there early.A plus is that they sell snacks and beverages and there's a bathroom on board! We would definitely recommend to friends — Michelle M, Sep. 2023

Wedding Day! Huge thank you to Portsmouth Harbor Cruises for adding such a special and unique touch to our wedding day for us and our bridal party! Our boat ride from downtown Portsmouth to our reception venue was a perfect way to show off our beautiful city and have an hour to ourselves & those closest to us before the craziness started! The Captain and the crew made it an experience we'll never forget! — Anna T, October 2024

Definitely worth it! I was apprehensive about taking the boat ride, but I’m glad I did. I saw a lot of really interesting historical buildings and learned a great deal from the captain about the harbor. We visited the naval yard, as well as beautiful homes and bridges. It was truly awesome.If you have the opportunity to do a two-hour ride, it's definitely worth it! —Lisa P, October 2024

A Must Do When Visiting Portsmouth We had an excellent private family charter of the boat for a special occasion. From start to finish the the experience was first rate. Both the captain and crew member / bartender were great to engage with, and provided excellent service. The cruise provides a memorable view of the Portsmouth harbor and outlying islands. — Stetsoninc, June 2021

Would do again! Great trip out into the bay. We took the noon Harbor Tour. The history was amazing! Not too much, plenty to see, the captain was great, and they have snacks + drinks for sale if you want! I felt like I was just out for a cruise with friends in the middle of bustling port life! Would go again! — Kay S, June 2024
